entities.summary: The Osmaniye Mosque, also locally known as the Frangomachala Mosque is a former mosque located inside the old citadel area of the town of Chios on the eponymous island, in the North Aegean region of Greece. The mosque was built in 1892 during the Ottoman era, was abandoned in 1912, and the building was subsequently repurposed for cultural use.
